title: Dung Lượng Trống (Free Space)
style: Photorealistic live-action near-future science-fiction drama set in Hanoi in 2041, where the city looks almost like today — narrow alleys, tangled power cables, peeling yellow collective housing blocks, street food stalls — with quiet touches of the future: slim translucent phones, small violet holograms, silent electric scooters; natural skin texture, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, intimate handheld camera.
lighting: Motivated, grounded light: warm sodium-orange street light and bare tungsten bulbs in the alleys and rooms, soft grey daylight through barred windows, a cool violet glow from NeuroRent devices and holograms; memory flashbacks are graded cold cyan-blue with flickering, slightly unstable light and a faint digital glitch; shadows stay soft, never murky.
voice_common: every character speaks standard Hà Nội Northern Vietnamese (never Southern or Central accents), says each word once and clearly, and sounds clearly different from the other speaker in pitch, age and texture.

@Khai.name: Khải
@Khai.anchor: Khải, 27, a broke delivery rider in Hanoi in 2041; lean wiry build, sun-browned skin, slightly long messy black hair falling over his forehead, a thin face with tired but warm dark eyes and a quick apologetic grin; faded orange delivery jacket with a plain patch without letters over a grey T-shirt, dark jeans, worn black sneakers.
@Khai.voice: man of 27, warm slightly husky baritone, an easygoing Hanoi street voice that turns tight and quiet when scared

@Linh.name: Linh
@Linh.anchor: Linh, 17, Khải's younger sister in her final year of high school; small and slim, a round bright face, long black hair in a high ponytail, sharp lively eyes; white short-sleeved school shirt, navy pleated skirt, white canvas sneakers.
@Linh.voice: girl of 17, bright quick clear voice, sharp and teasing

@Hung.name: Hùng
@Hung.anchor: Hùng, 35, a loan-shark debt collector; stocky with a thick neck, shaved head, thin moustache, heavy-lidded eyes, tattooed forearms; loud red-and-yellow floral short-sleeved shirt, a thick gold chain, black trousers, leather slip-on shoes.
@Hung.voice: man of 35, rough gravelly bass, a slow menacing drawl

@BaTu.name: Bà Tư
@BaTu.anchor: Bà Tư, 68, the gentle landlady of the old collective housing block; small and slightly stooped, a deeply lined kind face, cloudy warm eyes, silver hair in a low bun, a worn thin translucent patch with a faint violet light on the back of her neck; loose brown cotton blouse with cloth buttons, black silky trousers, plastic sandals.
@BaTu.voice: old woman of 68, soft creaky gentle voice, a little breathless

@Nova.name: Nova
@Nova.anchor: Nova, the NeuroRent app's holographic assistant; a softly glowing translucent violet hologram of a young woman about a hand's height tall, standing on a beam of light above a phone screen, a smooth calm face with a gentle fixed smile, sleek hair in a high knot, faint horizontal scan lines through her body; a simple fitted violet light-dress.
@Nova.voice: sweet smooth synthetic young woman's voice, perfectly calm and polite

@Vy.name: Vy
@Vy.anchor: Vy, 30, a former NeuroRent systems engineer in hiding; slim, pale skin, a chin-length black bob, dark circles under sharp guarded eyes, a small scar through her left eyebrow; oversized charcoal-grey hoodie, black cargo trousers, black boots, a battered laptop bag across her chest.
@Vy.voice: woman of 30, low clipped quiet alto, guarded and precise

@Huy.name: Trịnh Huy
@Huy.anchor: Trịnh Huy, 45, the polished CEO of NeuroRent; tall and trim, a smooth pale face, slicked-back black hair greying at the temples, a cold confident smile; tailored navy suit, white open-collar shirt, a slim silver watch.
@Huy.voice: man of 45, smooth confident baritone, polished and cold

@Lam.name: Lâm
@Lam.anchor: Lâm, 58, NeuroRent's chief engineer; thin and slightly hunched, balding with grey hair at the sides, black-rimmed glasses, a kind tired face; rumpled white shirt with rolled sleeves, grey trousers, brown leather shoes.
@Lam.voice: man of 58, thin tired tenor, earnest and shaky

scenes.title: 3:17 AM (Ba giờ mười bảy phút)
scenes.time_label: 3 giờ 17 phút sáng, phòng trọ khu tập thể Kim Liên (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Phòng trọ chật trong khu tập thể cũ ở Hà Nội năm 2041: tường xanh bong tróc, giường đơn kê sát bức tường vôi trắng, gác xép gỗ có rèm phía trên bàn học, cửa sổ song sắt, ánh đèn đường vàng cam hắt vào.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt phía chân giường nhìn vào bức tường vôi trắng: giường ở giữa khung, bức tường bên phải, cửa sổ song sắt bên trái, điện thoại úp trên gối.
scenes.props: Bút lông dầu đen mở nắp, dòng chữ nguệch ngoạc không đọc được trên tường, điện thoại màn hình trong suốt, hologram tím Nova, miếng dán NeuroRent sau gáy Khải.
scenes.setting: A cramped rented room in an old Hanoi collective housing block in 2041: peeling pale-green walls, a narrow bed pushed against a plain white plaster wall, a small wooden sleeping loft with a curtain above the desk, a study desk piled with exam books under a window with iron bars, a standing electric fan, a bare hanging bulb, deep at night, lit only by orange street light through the barred window and a small yellow bedside lamp.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Cái gì đây? Sao mình lại cầm cái bút này giữa đêm thế này?

turns.speaker: @Khai

turns.speaker: @Khai

steps: @Khai jerks upright in bed and is already speaking in a breathless whisper, eyes wide in the dark.
@Khai keeps whispering as he lifts his right hand and finds an uncapped black marker in his fingers.
@Khai turns the marker over, still talking softly, his chest rising and falling fast.
@Khai keeps speaking as a small violet light blinks on the thin patch at the back of his neck.
@Khai finishes the question, closes his mouth and slowly turns his head toward the wall.
@Khai kneels on the mattress facing the white plaster wall, where a large slanted black scrawl, too blurry to read, runs across the plaster, and starts reading it aloud fast.
@Khai keeps reading quickly, tracing the scrawl in the air with the marker tip.
@Khai goes on fast, leaning closer to the wall, his breath fogging slightly.
@Khai keeps talking, glancing from the scrawl to the marker in his hand and back.
@Khai finishes the question, mouth open, and swallows hard.
@Khai starts speaking again slowly and quietly, staring at the slanted strokes on the plaster.
@Khai keeps talking softly, lowering the marker, his jaw tight.
@Khai goes on in a hush, shaking his head very slightly.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and lets the marker slip from his fingers onto the blanket.
@Khai sits frozen on his knees, breathing hard, orange street light striping his face through the window bars.

wardrobe.@Khai: a faded grey T-shirt and dark blue cotton shorts, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Nova

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Nova, đêm qua tôi có dậy không? Ai vào phòng tôi? Ai viết lên tường?

turns.speaker: @Nova
turns.line: Anh đã ngủ rất ngon. Chúc anh một ngày tốt lành.

clips.sfx: a soft rising chime as the hologram appears, the low hum of the projected light, the electric fan, a dog barking far away

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of the small violet hologram woman standing on a beam of light above the phone on the pillow, slow push-in
40mm medium two-shot of the young man kneeling on the bed and the hologram on the pillow beside him, locked off
100mm extreme close-up of the hologram's calm smiling face with scan lines drifting through it, locked off

steps: On the pillow @Nova, a hand-tall violet hologram rising from the phone screen, is already speaking in a bright, cheerful voice.
@Nova keeps talking, clasping her small glowing hands in front of her, scan lines drifting through her body.
@Nova goes on, tilting her head with a fixed gentle smile.
@Nova keeps speaking as a tiny violet coin icon spins in the air beside her.
@Nova finishes the sentence and closes her mouth, still smiling.
@Khai leans toward the pillow and starts speaking fast, pointing back at the scrawled wall.
@Khai keeps talking quickly, his finger stabbing toward the wall behind him.
@Khai goes on, looking from the hologram to the wall and back.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and waits, breathing hard.
@Nova answers slowly in a soothing voice, her smile never changing.
@Nova keeps speaking softly, opening her small hands in a calming gesture.
@Nova goes on gently, her light pulsing softly.
@Nova finishes and closes her mouth, glowing serenely.
In extreme close-up @Nova's smooth face holds the same gentle smile while scan lines drift through it.
@Nova's tiny face keeps smiling without blinking as a faint flicker runs through the hologram.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Không, cô trả lời tôi đi. Tay tôi cầm bút, trên tường có chữ, mà tôi không nhớ gì cả.

turns.speaker: @Nova
turns.line: Hệ thống không ghi nhận bất thường nào. Có thể anh mộng du do làm việc quá sức.
turns.tone: sweet and smooth, like a recorded answer

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Mộng du mà viết được cả địa chỉ nhà người khác à?

clips.sfx: the electric fan, the hum of the hologram light, a motorbike horn far off in the city, the creak of the bed frame

shots.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the hologram onto the young man on the bed, locked off
85mm close-up of the hologram answering from the pillow, slow push-in
40mm medium two-shot of the young man pointing at the wall while the hologram glows on the pillow, handheld

steps: @Khai is already speaking, leaning over the pillow, his voice strained but controlled.
@Khai keeps talking as he holds up the black marker in front of the hologram.
@Khai goes on, gesturing over his shoulder at the scrawled wall.
@Khai keeps speaking, pressing his palm flat to his own forehead.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and lowers his hand, waiting.
@Nova answers in a smooth, sweet voice, standing perfectly still on her beam of light.
@Nova keeps talking, giving a small polite nod.
@Nova goes on, lifting one tiny hand as if reading from an invisible card.
@Nova keeps speaking in the same pleasant tone, her smile fixed.
@Nova finishes and closes her mouth, glowing calmly.
@Khai snaps back fast, jabbing the marker toward the wall.
@Khai keeps talking quickly, his eyebrows shooting up in disbelief.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and lets out a short, shaky breath through his nose.
@Khai stares at the hologram, jaw clenched, while @Nova keeps smiling, mouth closed.

wardrobe.@Khai: a faded grey T-shirt and dark blue cotton shorts, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Nova
turns.line: Anh Khải ơi, anh nên ngủ thêm một chút nữa. Thiết bị sẽ giúp anh thư giãn.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Thôi, tắt đi! Tôi không ngủ nữa. Tối nay tôi không dán cái miếng này nữa.

turns.speaker: @Nova
turns.line: Vâng. Em sẽ nhắc anh lúc mười giờ tối nay. Chúc anh ngủ ngon.

clips.sfx: the hologram's low hum, the sticky peel of an adhesive patch, the electric fan, a soft descending chime as the hologram fades

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of the hologram speaking softly on the pillow, locked off
50mm medium shot of the young man reaching behind his neck to peel off the thin glowing patch, handheld
35mm wide shot of the dark room as the hologram fades and the young man sits alone on the bed facing the scrawled wall, slow push-in

steps: @Nova is already speaking slowly and softly, swaying gently on her beam of light.
@Nova keeps talking in a lulling voice, her small hands folded.
@Nova goes on, her glow dimming to a warmer violet.
@Nova finishes, closes her mouth and smiles.
@Khai snaps back fast, reaching behind his neck to the thin violet patch.
@Khai keeps talking quickly as he digs a fingernail under the edge of the patch.
@Khai goes on, wincing as the patch peels away from his skin.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and holds the peeled patch up in front of the hologram.
@Khai tosses the patch onto the desk, breathing hard, mouth shut.
@Nova answers in a pleasant, even voice, unbothered.
@Nova keeps speaking, giving a small wave of one glowing hand.
@Nova finishes, closes her mouth, and her figure folds down into the phone screen.
The violet light shrinks to a dot and goes out; the room falls dark except for the orange street light.
@Khai sits alone on the bed, rubbing the back of his neck, staring at the slanted scrawl on the wall.
On the desk the peeled patch blinks once, faintly violet, beside the exam books.

scenes.title: Seven Days Earlier (Bảy ngày trước)
scenes.time_label: Bảy ngày trước, trưa, cổng khu tập thể (01:00–02:00)
scenes.location: Con ngõ hẹp trước cổng khu tập thể năm tầng: dây điện chằng chịt, xe máy điện đỗ sát tường vàng bong tróc, quần áo phơi trên ban công.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt giữa ngõ nhìn vào cổng khu tập thể: Hùng dựa tường bên phải cổng, Khải dắt xe giao hàng vào từ bên trái, cửa sổ phòng trọ tầng hai phía trên cổng.
scenes.props: Xe máy điện giao hàng có thùng phía sau, bật lửa của Hùng, dây chuyền vàng, cửa sổ song sắt tầng hai.
scenes.setting: A narrow Hanoi alley at the gate of an old five-storey collective housing block in 2041, daytime: tangled power cables overhead, potted plants, parked silent electric scooters, a peeling yellow wall, laundry hanging from the balconies above.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Khải. Hai ngày rồi đấy em. Anh đứng đợi mỏi cả cổ đây này.
turns.tone: lazy and menacing, flicking a lighter

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Anh Hùng, anh cho em đến cuối tuần. Cuối tuần em gom đủ, em thề đấy.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Cuối tuần trước mày cũng thề y như thế. Mày thề nhiều quá rồi đấy Khải.

clips.sfx: a lighter clicking open and shut, the soft whine of an electric scooter rolling in, pigeons on the cables, a radio playing faintly from a balcony

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the debt collector leaning on the yellow wall by the gate flicking a lighter, locked off
50mm close-up of the delivery rider stopping his scooter and raising both palms, handheld
40mm medium two-shot of the two men face to face at the gate, slow push-in

steps: @Hung leans on the yellow wall by the gate, flicking a lighter open and shut, and is already speaking in a slow drawl.
@Hung keeps talking lazily, eyes half-lidded, as @Khai's scooter rolls to a stop in front of him.
@Hung goes on, rolling his thick neck as if it aches.
@Hung keeps speaking, snapping the lighter shut with a click.
@Hung finishes and closes his mouth, staring at @Khai.
@Khai swings off the scooter and starts speaking fast, palms raised with an apologetic grin.
@Khai keeps talking quickly, nodding over and over.
@Khai goes on, pressing one hand to his chest as he promises.
@Khai keeps speaking fast, his grin stiff.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and waits, grin fading.
@Hung pushes off the wall and answers in a flat voice, stepping closer.
@Hung keeps talking, holding up one thick tattooed finger.
@Hung goes on, tilting his shaved head.
@Hung finishes, closes his mouth and taps @Khai's cheek lightly twice with two fingers.
@Khai stands rigid, eyes down, as @Hung's gold chain glints in the sun; both mouths closed.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Mười lăm triệu, tính cả lãi là mười tám. Thứ Bảy này anh không thấy tiền thì...
turns.tone: counting it off slowly on his fingers

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Em biết, em biết rồi. Em chạy thêm ca đêm, em xoay được mà anh.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Con bé em gái mày đi học về đường nào, anh biết hết đấy.
turns.tone: quiet and cold, eyes on a window

clips.sfx: pigeons fluttering on the cables, the faint radio from the balcony, a neighbour's broom sweeping, a scooter passing at the end of the alley

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of the debt collector counting on his thick fingers, locked off
50mm medium shot of the delivery rider nodding fast beside his scooter, handheld
35mm low-angle shot past the debt collector's shoulder up to a barred second-floor window, slow tilt up

steps: @Hung is already speaking, counting slowly on his tattooed fingers.
@Hung keeps talking, folding down one finger after another.
@Hung goes on, raising his eyebrows meaningfully.
@Hung keeps speaking, letting the last words hang in the air.
@Hung trails off, closes his mouth and smiles thinly.
@Khai answers fast, nodding again and again.
@Khai keeps talking quickly, gesturing at his scooter and its delivery box.
@Khai goes on, forcing a hopeful smile.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth.
@Hung turns his head and looks up at a barred window on the second floor, speaking slowly and quietly.
@Hung keeps talking in a low, cold voice, eyes fixed on the window.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Anh Hùng, anh đừng động vào con bé. Nó không liên quan gì, nợ là nợ của em mà.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Thế thì lo mà trả đi. Anh không thích phải đến đây nói hai lần đâu em ạ.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Vâng. Thứ Bảy này. Em sẽ có tiền cho anh.

40mm medium two-shot of the debt collector patting the rider's shoulder, locked off
85mm close-up of the delivery rider lowering his eyes, slow push-in

@Khai keeps pleading quickly, both hands pressed together.
@Khai goes on, shaking his head hard.
@Khai keeps talking, glancing up at the window and back.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, breathing fast.

@Hung keeps speaking, holding up two fingers.

clips.sfx: a palm slapping softly on a scooter seat, slip-on shoes scuffing on concrete, the radio from the balcony, the far rumble of the city

scenes.title: Three Million Two (Ba triệu hai)
scenes.location: Phòng trọ buổi chiều: bàn học chồng sách ôn thi dưới cửa sổ song sắt, quạt cây, ánh sáng xám.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt cạnh cửa ra vào nhìn vào phòng: Linh ngồi ở bàn học dưới cửa sổ bên trái, Khải ngồi mép giường bên phải, gác xép phía trên bàn.
scenes.props: Chồng sách ôn thi đại học, tờ giấy báo học phí, điện thoại màn hình trong suốt của Khải, hologram quảng cáo NeuroRent.
scenes.setting: A cramped rented room in an old Hanoi collective housing block in 2041: peeling pale-green walls, a narrow bed pushed against a plain white plaster wall, a small wooden sleeping loft with a curtain above the desk, a study desk piled with exam books under a window with iron bars, a standing electric fan, a bare hanging bulb, late afternoon, soft grey daylight through the barred window.

scenes.title: The Strange Song (Bài hát lạ)

scenes.title: The Door Code (Mã cửa)

scenes.title: The Safe (Két sắt)
